image_description: A close-up, high-contrast photograph of a bright green snake coiled tightly on a dark branch. The snake features vivid lime-green scales with a highly glossy texture. The head is visible in profile, showing a large dark eye and a distinct brow ridge. Crucially, the ventral side of the neck and lower jaw are visible due to the coiling posture, appearing bright yellow-green rather than pale white. The body loops around, displaying lateral compression and scale arrangement.
